verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows general tax calculation, jurisdiction mapping, nexus handling, and 200+ country coverage, but nothing documents real-time validation of VAT/tax IDs against official registries (e.g., VIES) or automatic application of reverse-charge logic for B2B cross-border transactions. Missing for 10: VAT ID/registry validation API, reverse-charge determination logic, B2B cross-border specific documentation or examples.
